# Feature coverage

<!-- Generated by `pnpm features:matrix --write` from test/features/inventory.ts, the fixture
     table in features.test.ts and the cases in plan.test.ts. Edit those, not this file. -->

78 features: 66 covered on at least one tier, 12 known gaps. Features per tier: unit 59, plan 16, fake 19, docker 22, real 6.

- **unit**: plain `node:test` cases, including runner-level tests through the CLI
- **plan**: `es run --dry-run --json` snapshots in `plan.test.ts`
- **fake**, **docker**, **real**: feature fixtures in `features.test.ts` on the fake sandbox, in Docker, and with real Cursor
- `● n`: n fixtures, each with a canary that must fail · `◐ n`: some without one · `✓ n`: n cases or tests · `—`: nothing

## Known gaps

- **`.env` and `.env.local` loading** (`config.dotenv`): No test writes either file, though every command loads them (src/env.ts).
- **`limit.compare.maxVariants`** (`profiles.max-variants`): No plan case or test sets it.
- **`group.skip` and `group.todo`** (`selection.group-skip`): Only `group.only` and the `evaluate` forms are tested; a skipped group's evals aren't.
- **`skill.registry`** (`skill.registry`): No test: it needs a fake registry.
- **`skill.npm`** (`skill.npm`): No test: it needs a local tarball or registry.
- **`only` naming a missing skill** (`skill.only-missing`): The error (environment/resolve.ts) has no test.
- **`mcp.sse`** (`mcp.sse`): No test builds an SSE server entry.
- **`docker({ from })` toolchain images** (`docker.from`): Only `es image build --dry-run`'s listing is tested; building on a `from` image and running in it is manual (test-strategy §11.4, I2).
- **A real judge model call** (`judge.real`): Tests use `fakeJudge`; provider resolution is unit-tested, a model call isn't.
- **`es compare --fail-on-regression`** (`compare.fail-on-regression`): No test passes the flag.
- **Exit code precedence (a failure and an infra error in one run)** (`exit-precedence`): No test has both in one run.
- **`--log-order`, `--log-prefix` and `--output-logs` through `es run`** (`output.flags`): The renderers are tested on recorded events; no test passes the flags to `es run`.
